caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur, centrally placed on a plain beige background. The spur features a gold and brass-colored, ornately shaped body with engraved decorative details. Its main body is curved and bulbous in parts, with two rings forming loops on either end. Attached at one end is a large, black rowel (the rotating wheel with pointed tips), which has eight spokes radiating outward. There are two black leather straps fastened around the body of the spur, one of which has a round, silver concho or disc attached to it. The text “POST CAMPBELL GENRE” appears in small, capitalized red letters below the spur, slightly left of center. The drawing is done in a realistic style, with subtle shading and highlights to emphasize the metallic texture. All objects and text are concentrated in the central area, leaving a broad, empty border of beige page around them.
title: Spur
